value.rationale: Determines a motivated, previously quantitative-gap boundary between positive-invasion coexistence and negative-invasion exclusion: a globally valid critical extinction law, explicit periodic amplitude, a season-independent weighted load constant equal to one, and a logarithmic cumulative-response prediction. These distinguish pulse/seasonal interventions with the same zero Floquet invasion exponent, beyond routine textbook sign tests or finite numerical observations.
